goblin-scrounger: If it glows, it's his. If it doesn't, he'll lick it until it does.
goblin-scrapper: He has never won a fight fairly. He has never lost one either.
goblin-slinger: Free shipping, mostly because nobody wants the skulls back.
goblin-bomber: He washes his hands with gunpowder. Twice a day.
goblin-sneak: You'll never see him coming. You'll barely see him leaving.
wolf-rider: The wolf is also very angry. Nobody asked it.
goblin-grunt: He has a bucket for a helmet and a plan for nothing.
goblin-smith-miner: Fixes anything with enough sparks and bad language.
rotgut-grenadier: Never drink the grenades. Learned twice.
shiv-rat: It's the small knives you should worry about. And the rats.
junk-shaman: The spirits speak in rattles and an occasional 'clang'.
blastrat-sapper: He hugs the barrel. The barrel does not hug back.
gnome-prospector: Has waited three weeks for this exact rock.
spark-gnome: Do not shake his hand. You'll regret it. Briefly.
clockwork-beetle: Wind it up and run. Not necessarily in that order.
gnome-illusionist: The rabbit was never real. The bill, however...
gyrocopter-ace: Flies low, fast and slightly sideways.
the-great-steam-golem: Please keep fingers, beards and cats away from the valve.
overclocked-conduit: Humming is normal. Smoking is also normal. Screaming is new.
gnome-smith-miner: Adds a little brass to every problem.
gnome-cogger: A very small cog. But an important one.
gnome-widget: Nobody knows what it does. It does it very well.
hexwright-apprentice: Page two was stuck to page three. It went fine.
gearward-sentinel: Politely asks you to leave. Then impolitely.
runic-siphoner: Borrowing is such an ugly word.
phase-stalker: Blink and you'll miss him. Blink again and he's behind you.
glyphshield-warden: Reads like a warning. Works like one too.
dwarf-miner: Has never met a rock he respected.
shieldbeard: Mostly the beard. The shield is a backup.
axe-thrower: Always has one more axe. Always.
ironhammer-berserker: Calm down? He tried that once. Hated it.
brewmaster: Taste test required before battle. Several.
ram-rider: The ram has the brains. The dwarf has the beard.
queen-brunhilda-stonebeard: Her beard has its own throne. And a tax.
crystal-drunk-delver: Never trust a dwarf who hums at the crystals.
dwarf-stoneback: Is the wall. Has opinions about the wall.
oathbound-pikeman: Long on oaths, longer on reach.
deepforge-crossbowman: Aims like a dwarf, which is mostly forward.
barrelback-courier: Do not open. Do not shake. Do not ask.
grimhold-ravager: Has a list. Is on it.
prospectors-prayer: Dear rocks: please be crystals. Love, us.
tunnel-rush: The shortest path is straight down, then up.
fireball: Delivered in 30 seconds or it's free. It is never free.
meteor-strike: Aim for the biggest problem. Hit the biggest problem.
healing-light: Tastes faintly of mint and bandages.
fizzle: The spell sputters, coughs and gives up.
hold-it: Time out. For everyone but you.
spell-snap: Your spell, my spell, same spell.
mirror-hex: Have you tried not casting that?
mama-grubsnout: Twelve piglets, one apron, zero patience.
pox-doctor-ratsbane: The cure is worse. The cure is always worse.
sooey-hog-call: One toot of the bugle and the ground starts to squeal.
snot-sergeant-gurk: The helmet is bigger than he is. So is the whistle.
fizzwick-fuse-lighter: He lost the eyebrows in an accident. He lost the next pair on purpose.
bogwater-brewer: Nobody knows what is in the cauldron. The cauldron knows.
runt-piglet: Sharp at one end and loud at the other.
bang-snap-imp: He is very proud of the firework. The firework does not know him.
sludge-lobber: Tongue out, eyes shut, bucket full.
wispmother-tallulah: Her wisps are not pets. They are grandchildren.
jinxmaster-wobblewick: The hats keep him balanced. The twitch keeps him interesting.
chain-lightning: It picks the next victim by smell. Mostly burning.
hexfuse-battery-golem: Do not lick the antennae. Everyone has to learn once.
rune-scribe-nimbletoe: Roller skates in a library. Runes in a hurry.
lens-grinder-lorelei: She has never missed a thing. Twice, in fact.
hexbolt-tinker: Every bolt says "oops". The targets agree.
spark-caddy: Four jars of wisps and a very small trolley.
stray-spark-wisp: It wandered off. It is still surprised about it.
hex-cadet: The runes on the wrench are spelled wrong. It still works.
ratchet-runt: Rides the robots. Fixes the robots. Names the robots.
engineer-cogsworth: He builds mules because horses do not take blueprints.
forgemaster-hildegrim: Do not stand downwind of the beard.
stand-fast-lads: A very small flag. A very large refusal to move.
shieldwall-sergeant-brasha: The walls do not want to march. The walls march.
master-smith-durga: Her sparks come out heart-shaped. She denies it.
grumble-drummer: Two turkey legs, one drum, no shame.
mule-wrangler-nessa: The mules chew crystals. She lets them.
stonebreaker-miner: The pickaxe is taller than him. So is the lunch.
shield-cadet: The helmet covers his eyes. He is fine with it.
pebble-tosser: They are not pebbles. Nobody is asking.
hammerhand-apprentice: Flexes before every swing. Sometimes after.
piglet: Vicious, tiny, and absolutely certain of itself.
spark-wisp: It glows, it bites, it fizzles. In that order.
clockwork-mule: It eats crystals and does not say thank you.
